**Evidence and rationale:**

## Checklist

- [ ] I opened every cited source myself; no reference was guessed.
- [ ] `NR`, `?` and `0` are used correctly; every `0` lists `sources_reviewed`.
- [ ] New findings are `verification: needs_review`. Only a different reviewer may mark them `verified`.
- [ ] No personal data, no allegations, no names of individuals.
- [ ] `npm run validate-data` passes.
